ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework" ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Deal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Cross-Sell/Upsell"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "High Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Medium Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Low Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "No Touch") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "RIM"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "Digital"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "ALM") ),
NOT(ISBLANK(IM_Booked_Date__c)),
OR( IM_Booked_Date__c < TODAY(), IM_Booked_Date__c < CloseDate ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First Bill Date cannot be in the past or prior to the Close Date.
